culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At Soma Nomaoi the organisers ask viewers not to cross in front of horses or the procession, not to look down on the procession from high places, not to stand behind horses, not to use flash on horses, and not to reach out suddenly or shout at them. In rain, wear a raincoat rather than holding an umbrella, which blocks people behind.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Photographs are free outside closed areas, and your own photos may be used freely. Drones and selfie sticks are banned for safety.
culture-and-protocol.note: Soma Nomaoi only, from the organisers' FAQ.

festivals.what: Soma Nomaoi (Soma, Minamisoma and Namie): held every year over the last Saturday, Sunday and Monday of May. Day 1 departures and evening races; day 2 the armoured procession, armour horse racing and the sacred-flag contest at Hibarigahara (Minamisoma); day 3 Nomakake at Odaka Shrine. It goes ahead in rain but can be called off under weather or disaster warnings; roads around venues close.
